component.name: dev-prompt
component.summary: Command-palette overlay for launching dev repositories

description.p: dev-prompt is a global-hotkey overlay that finds the repositories on your machine, shows where each one stands, and opens its action menu: press the hotkey, type a few letters, hit Enter. Every repo shows its branch and anything uncommitted, unpushed or left half-done, in Git, Jujutsu, Mercurial, Subversion, Fossil or Breezy. The menu is built by reading the project — its package.json scripts through the right package manager, cargo, Go, Python, .NET, Docker Compose, Makefile and justfile targets, sub-projects — and only offers tools that are actually installed.

ul.li: See which repos need you: uncommitted changes, unpushed commits, stashes, a stopped rebase
Switch branches, open a second working copy, pull, push and fetch in one keystroke
Open a repo in your editor, terminal or file manager, or run its scripts
A shell right inside the overlay that keeps running in the background
Clone a repository by pasting its address, or create one with version control set up
Move a repo to the Trash after checking for unpushed or uncommitted work
Type > to launch any installed application instead

description.p: It stays out of the way the rest of the time: no window, a single tray icon, and a rules file that maps each project to the actions that make sense for it.

screenshot.caption: Fuzzy-search every repository under your code folders
Each repo's action menu, built from the scripts and tools the project actually uses
Type > to switch to an installed-application launcher

Every running shell in one list, to jump into or close
